'''Ali''' (''’Àlī'') is a [[Gbaya language]] of the southwestern [[Central African Republic]]. Ngbaka Manza is closer to ’Ali proper than it is to its namesakes [[Manza language|Manza]] or [[Ngbaka language|Ngbaka]], though all may be mutually intelligible to some extent.
